name: Newport Pavilion Shopping Center
description: Newport Pavilion is a bustling shopping destination located in Newport, Kentucky, offering a diverse range of retail options to cater to the needs of locals and visitors alike. This modern retail hub features an array of stores with convenient interstate access via I-471, ample parking, and a family-friendly atmosphere. Strategically positioned with over half a mile of interstate frontage and immediate access to two full interchanges, Newport Pavilion stands out as a premier location for shopping, dining, and entertainment in the Newport area.
demographics: Located just across the Ohio River from Cincinnati with strategic access along I-471, serving the Newport, Kentucky community and nearby Cincinnati metropolitan area
summary: A modern shopping destination in Newport, Kentucky with excellent interstate access, offering diverse retail, dining, and entertainment options for locals and Cincinnati-area visitors.
